Collects Windows Event logs (4688, 4624, 4625, 4720) across hosts via a custom Python agent with simulated threats; 10 MITRE ATT&CK-mapped Sigma rules with brute-force correlation (cut 35 false positives/hr with no missed true positives); analyst triage with entity pivoting and ±10-min timelines, API-key auth, 225 automated tests. JavaFX side-scroller: 3-character switching, 4 enemy AI types, multi-phase boss across 5 maps; strict OOP (interfaces, abstract classes, UML), custom 60 FPS loop, AABB collision and physics; scene navigation, upgrade tree, audio, debug overlays; shipped as an executable JAR.
